day_shape: 93 items: Tehran four-party security meeting with Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia dominates regime cycle, IDF reports multiple Gaza strikes killing Hamas/PIJ operatives, Pezeshkian flies to Moscow for GECF, Bessent predicts 25%+ Iran economic contraction, Israeli election eve coverage.

threads.label: Tehran four-party regional security meeting
threads.summary: Iran hosted Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia for a four-party regional security meeting in Tehran, with a joint press statement issued by SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei. Regime outlets quoted Bagheri Kani and Rezaei framing the outcome as 'endogenous' security, while Iran International reported hardline paper Kayhan warned the diplomacy risked relieving US pressure.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and tunnel discoveries
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes killing four Hamas and PIJ operatives across Gaza over the weekend, a separate strike on three operatives emerging from a Khan Younis tunnel beyond the Yellow Line, and two Hamas commanders killed earlier. Troops also uncovered a 15-metre underground shaft near the home of a Judea Junction attacker who killed two IDF soldiers.

threads.label: Israeli election eve and Iran framing
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel covered Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu urging re-election to 'finish the job' against Iran, with analyses on the Iran-threat framing dominating the vote. The IDF issued a statement denying reports of a confrontation between Chief of Staff Lt.-Gen. Eyal Zamir and Netanyahu over handling a potential war with Iran.

threads.label: Khamenei medallist message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message addressed to elites and scientific and sports medallists at the 'Country-loving Medallists' event, with Defa Press and IRIB amplifying extracts framing scientific power as the key to a 'strong Iran'. Khamenei also referenced assassinations of scientists during the 'third imposed war'.

threads.label: Iran economic pressure and shortages
threads.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Iran International Iran's economy would contract by more than 25% in the year to March 2027 and urged Iranians to stock up on fuel. Iran International also reported flour shortages closing bakeries in several cities and two Iran Air retirees dying after forgoing unaffordable treatment.

threads.label: Iraq-Iran border crossing dispute
threads.summary: An Iraqi court ordered the arrest of the Maysan provincial council chairman after he threatened civil disobedience and separation over the closure of the al-Shib border crossing with Iran, with PM Ali Al-Zaidi ordering an investigation. Defa Press reported an indefinite sit-in by Iraqi citizens protesting the closure.

threads.label: Pezeshkian Moscow trip and Yemen axis activity
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian departed for Moscow for the eighth Gas Exporting Countries Forum summit, with Putin set to meet him and Qatar's emir on Tuesday. Separately, Egypt's parliament authorised military support for Saudi Arabia against the Houthis, Jordan struck sites in southern Syria linked to a church attack, and Yemeni spokesman Yahya Saree claimed 3,300 Saudi strikes on Yemen.

events.title: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations
events.summary: This proposed rule sets forth regulations that would implement Subtitle C of the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, which is codified at Title VIII of the Defense Production Act. The proposed rule would require United States persons to provide notification to the U.S. Department of the Treasury regarding certain transactions involving foreign persons that are engaged in notifiable technologies; and prohibit United States persons from engaging in certain other transactions involving foreign persons that are engaged in prohibited technologies. Where consistent with Title VIII, the proposed rule incorporates certain definitions and concepts from the current regulations governing the Outbound Investment Security Program. The proposed rule also would add applicability dates to the regulations, such that those regulations would continue to apply to activities that occurred within the relevant timeframe.

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. The vessels placed on the SDN List have been identified as property in which a blocked person has an interest.
